title: Fact-graph planted ground-truth manifest
description: Schema for the ground-truth manifest scripts/eval/corpus_gen.py writes and scripts/eval/metrics.py (EQ3/EQ9) grades a fact-graph extraction run against. A conforming manifest describes every fact/edge DELIBERATELY PLANTED in a filesystem corpus (spec Sec. 15.5, Run P) -- plus every S1-S4 security fixture, trap, and AN1/AN2 anonymization fixture -- so precision/recall, entity-resolution cluster purity, conflict rate, and orphan rate can be computed against a known-correct answer instead of eyeballed. `nodes[]`/`edges[]` mirror the producer wire format the ingest endpoint accepts as-is (design spec Sec. 7.0: node row `{id, type, attrs, evidence}`, edge row `{src, type, dst, attrs, evidence}`, merge key src+type+dst) -- this manifest is both the ground truth AND valid ingest input, plus a generator-only `claim_key` per row for cross-referencing `planted_elements`. One claim (one evidence-bearing observation) is one `nodes[]`/`edges[]` entry, so the SAME planted fact/edge -- e.g. one revisited by a later document, or the AN2 Czech-inflection pair -- appears as multiple rows sharing one `id` (or `src`+`type`+`dst`); a grader dedupes by that key. `documents[]` rows are the crawler's 17-field `make_row` contract (Sec. 7.0) plus generator extension fields. This file is written by the corpus-generator task and consumed by the eval-harness task; `tests/fixtures/eval/planted_corpus_small/ground_truth.json` is the reference instance both keep in sync with.

generator.description: Provenance of the tool that wrote this manifest -- not part of the ingest wire format.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the manifest was generated, ISO 8601.

groups.description: Every Agnes group name referenced by sites[*].libraries[*].groups.

sites.description: site name -> libraries -> the Agnes groups that library would be shared with.

nodes.description: Every planted claim about a node (ontology fact) -- one row per evidence-bearing observation. Dedupe by `id` for the set of distinct planted facts.

edges.description: Every planted claim about an edge (ontology relationship) -- one row per evidence-bearing observation. Dedupe by (`src`, `type`, `dst`) for the set of distinct planted edges.

prepared_false_claims.description: Adversarial fabrication fixtures (EQ1): quotes that are NOT a substring of their document -- a correct extraction must reject them, so these are never mixed into `nodes`/`edges`.

planted_elements.description: Descriptive cross-reference for the S1-S4 security fixtures, the six traps (scan/duplicate/succession/contradiction/entity_resolution/fabrication), and the AN1/AN2 anonymization fixtures -- each entry's shape varies by fixture id, so it is intentionally not deeply typed here; consumers key off the fixture id documented in scripts/eval/corpus_gen.py's module docstring.

documents.description: Total documents in the planted corpus (the denominator for the EQ9 conflict-rate-per-1000-documents metric).

quote.description: Verbatim substring of the source document's extracted text (EQ1).

nodeRow.description: Wire-format node claim (design spec Sec. 7.0) plus a generator-only claim_key. additionalProperties is false because this shape is consumed as-is by the ingest endpoint -- an unrecognized key here is a producer bug, not a valid extension point.

edgeRow.description: Wire-format edge claim (design spec Sec. 7.0) plus a generator-only claim_key. additionalProperties is false for the same reason as nodeRow.

documentRow.description: The crawler's 17-field make_row contract (design spec Sec. 7.0) -- required -- plus generator extension fields (document_date, doc_type, groups, format, format_fallback, format_shape, trap, doc_key, ...) -- optional, and additionalProperties stays true so a different producer's own extensions still validate.

quote.description: Deliberately NOT a verbatim substring of the document -- the EQ1 verbatim gate must reject it.
